title: Don't Visit China During Golden Week (Oct 1-7) | China Travel Expert
description:
Here's my honest opinion as a China travel guide: don't plan your first China trip during National Day "Golden Week," October 1–7, 2026.

Last year, 888 million domestic trips happened in a single eight-day holiday. The famous sights and best hotels sell out months ahead, and Beijing alone is forecast to see close to 5 million travelers a day at peak. The real problem isn't price — it's that everything is simply full.

🧭 Expert Tip: If your dates are flexible, travel from October 8th onward (or the last days of September). Crowds thin out almost overnight, hotel availability returns, and eastern China's weather is at its best.

黄金周（10月1—7日）别来中国：去年八天假期出行8.88亿人次，景点酒店早早约满——10月8日以后再来，人少一半。
